card.title: Fluent in Nonsense
card.instruction: Perform complete mastery of the strange logic while inventing each rule only when it becomes necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we sell this bottled cloud, measure from its third elbow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the new assistant. I can only find two.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The third appears when addressed by its professional title. Say 'Professor.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Professor. It's raining inside the bottle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Those are its credentials. Count the drops; that gives us its sleeve size.

mechanism: A performs expert control of a bottled cloud by inventing precise instructions whenever B's observation defeats the prior one.
confusable: Unlike sincerely discovering a hidden rule, A must claim mastery while supplying rules only after they become useful.
comparison: Cloud anatomy and academic address produce invented measurement rules; gravity-dial manners produce escalating furniture etiquette.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
